newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FINMIN SAYS ECONOMY WAS STABLE IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: FINMIN SAYS ECONOMY WAS STABLE IN 1996.

text.p: The Estonian finance ministry said on Wednesday that in 1996 the economy was stable and was in line with forecasts.
The service sector as a proportion of GDP grew by 56 percent in 1996 compared to 1995, the ministry said in a statement.
Inflation decreased significantly in 1996 against 1995 with the price rise of consumer goods and services decreasing by an average of 14.8 percent to be half of 1995's rate, the ministry added.
The construction sector grew by 21 percent in 1996 and is now worth 7.7 billion kroons in current prices including renovation and restoration work, the ministry said.
